entries.description: Extend the `docs/modules.yaml` entry shape with the fields tiers 5–7 need — `codeRoots`, `specSections`, `contextAssets` — additively, so entries written by today's `modules.py` stay valid and the extension keeps rendering them. Reject an unknown key rather than ignoring it.

Add `context_scope.py`: given a diff and a module slug, resolve the seven tiers and return a structured scope. Tiers 1–3 carry full content; tier 4 carries interface surface only, extracted by parsing rather than by asking a model, one hop, comments excluded; tiers 5–6 come from the manifest; tier 7 is names only. Everything unmatched is excluded, and the scope records what it excluded and why — an exclusion nobody can see is indistinguishable from a bug.

Fold `prompting.py` into `route.py` and replace the silent tail-truncation with a refusal that names the overrun, the budget, and the module-scoping remedy. Assert in a test that no code path returns a silently truncated prompt.
Required portion of the full test suite.
Extended the docs/modules.yaml entry shape with codeRoots, specSections and contextAssets; unknown keys are rejected, entries written by the old writer stay valid.
Added context_scope.py: seven tiers resolved mechanically -- 1-4 bounded by the change, 5-7 by the module -- with every exclusion recorded and its reason.
Folded prompting.py into route.py and replaced the silent tail-truncation with PromptTooLargeError naming the overrun, the budget and the module-scoping remedy; prompting.py deleted.

Cross-provider verification through copilot-cli: 3 rounds, each finding a distinct real defect, each remediated -- r1 tier 4 blind to extensionless TS imports (gpt-5.5/openai); r2 the TS extractor kept bodies and dropped contracts (gemini-3.1-pro-preview/google); r3 code contradicted the locked spec, resolved by an operator-directed spec amendment (gpt-5.5/openai). Round cap reached; r3 finding 0 disputed on the record; adjudication unavailable (every seat provider had already participated); operator attested the waiver at an interactive prompt.

Full Python suite green: 449 passed in 140s, against the 480-test ceiling (414 before this session; +35 for the manifest validation, the seven-tier scope, the prompt-size refusal, and the truncation false-positive).
Closed WAIVED: five gates green, work committed as d5d1b782 and pushed. Verdict is the operator waiver on round 3 finding 0, adjudication having been unavailable.
